assumptions.text: Plant coordinates represent town centroids for each facility.
Five-band rating thresholds calibrated once after initial data pull (Heat: <2/10/30/60 days ≥40°C; Rain Rx1day: <45/64.5/95/124.5 mm; Water: Aqueduct 0–5 bands; Cyclone: <1/2.5/5/8 per decade).
assumptions.value: Fixed v1.0 bands (testable in Challenge Mode)

assumptions.text: 'High exposure' means rated High (4) or Very High (5) using ensemble median.
WRI Aqueduct 4.0 2040 water stress is linearly interpolated between published 2030 and 2050 projections.
Clinker dependencies extracted from CSV notes: P01→P07 (1.12 Mt), P06→P08 (0.68 Mt), P06→P09 (0.60 Mt).
Outage what-if defaults: 30-day kiln outage, 0 days stock buffer, 0% bought-in clinker replacement (gross exposure).
FY 2025-26 revenue (₹9,658 cr) is a proxy for business exposure, not modelled financial loss or EBITDA impact.
No site-level adaptation measures (e.g., flood walls, cooling upgrades) are credited in v1 baseline ratings; P07 desalination is noted qualitatively.
Coastal storm frequency uses historical NOAA IBTrACS tracks (1980–2024 within 200 km); future cyclone frequency is not projected.

Open-Meteo HighResMIP provides a high-emission pathway; SSP2-4.5 and SSP1-2.6 deltas are scaled using IPCC AR6 South Asia warming ratios. All 9 plants use direct Open-Meteo CMIP6 HighResMIP 4-model pulls.
